clause.quote: If the second character is not a letter but is a numeral `0` - `9` or `-` or `_`, then it MUST be either a selector for a different Count Code table or an error.

description: The count code -0AL has the numeral 0 as its second character. The specification reserves numerals for other count code tables, and genus 2.00 defines none, so the code is an error. (keripy 1.x used -0 as its big-count selector; genus 2.00 uses --.)
title: Reject a count code whose second character selects no defined table
